length_limits.notes: Research Articles have no maximum, but authors are asked to stay under 5,000 words of main text, excluding Materials and Methods, references and figure legends, with no limit on display items. Short Reports are 1,500 words with 3 to 4 display items; Review Articles up to about 10,000 words; Feature Articles under 2,000 words with up to 20 references.

figure_spec.notes: Minimum physical width 10 cm, or 20 cm for a full-page-width figure, both at 300 dpi. No multi-page figures and no figure supplements. Minimise whitespace; Colour Universal Design principles are recommended.

reference_style.style: Any reference style is accepted and reformatted in production; APA is the closest match to eLife's own. DOIs are requested where possible.

submission_steps: submit directly, or transfer a preprint from bioRxiv or medRxiv, or come through Review Commons
eLife reviews the preprint and publishes a Reviewed Preprint with an assessment and public reviews rather than accepting or rejecting
request a Version of Record later if you want one
a cover letter is required for Review Articles and Replication Studies and for disclosing data-sharing exceptions or preregistration
the publishing fee was $3,750 as of July 2026, with waivers

template.notes: A LaTeX template zip downloads without a login; DOCX and RTF are also accepted. Linked, never stored.

license_of_summary_source.statement: The guide is hosted on eLife's submission platform, whose footer carries a software notice rather than a content licence; eLife's own Terms and Conditions apply and its articles are CC BY 4.0.
